$job..validate: newData.val() == null || (newData.hasChildren(['request_id','suffix','status','source']) && newData.child('request_id').isString() && newData.child('suffix').isString() && newData.child('suffix').val().matches(/^\d{5}$/) && newData.child('status').isString() && (newData.child('status').val() == 'PENDING' || newData.child('status').val() == 'ACK') && newData.child('source').val() == 'ANDROID_POC')
